actual_scope: The two-pair off-diagonal exchange for the six-source weight-3 count at characteristic 7, under the inherited centre-only free-type hypothesis. The question is whether (9, 15) and one of (10, 14), (11, 13), or (33, 33) can be new at the same time, disjoint from (0, 3), and finish the 20 weight-3 masks. This package shows joint newness occurs and that the cover is still at most 7. Unrestricted c=7 existence stays open.
scope_change_reason: The catalogue card asks for one new connector operation. This package keeps the unsigned dirty connector alphabet fixed and answers open question 1 of the one-index exchange: whether two off-diagonal weight-3 pairs can finish the count when the diagonal image is small. A new operation is not the missing step.
bottleneck_link: Side result on the recursive-interface schedule. It does not change a supplier, a consumer, or kappa. It bounds the two-pair replacement inside the weight-3 count at c=7 and leaves the full depth-two question open.
stop_rule: Stop once every centre-only chain with a weight-3 (9, 15) sum is classified, or stop if one such chain and the named pairs cover all 20 weight-3 masks.
evidence: Exhaustive free-type census: the only weight-3 (9, 15) pairs are the 20 complement shapes. The diagonal image then has size at most 6, (0, 3) and (33, 33) add nothing, and the structural cover is at most 9. The 31788 walks per mask tighten this to 7, attained by 3276 walks with only the complement new. 1044 walks have two or more new masks and cover at most 6; 72 of them have all three of (9, 15), (10, 14), and (11, 13) new. Two explicit words realize covers 4 and 7. A one-letter mutation is rejected.

open_questions.question: On a centre-only chain whose (9, 15) sum is not weight 3, can (10, 14) and (11, 13) be new at the same time and push the weight-3 cover to 20?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The collapse proved here uses the complement shape, so a chain that misses (9, 15) could still be the route to 20 masks. Separate endpoint equalities suggest an image of size at most 16 and a cover of at most 19, but that counting is not proved in this package.

open_questions.blocked_by: Those walks are outside the 31788 complement windows classified here.
